# Pairadise Resort

> Pairadise Resort is a quiet, garden-and-pond bungalow resort in Pai, Mae Hong Son, Thailand, a 10-15 minute walk or short scooter ride from Pai's walking street, cafes, and night market. Rooms are private bungalows with air conditioning, private bathrooms, and free high-speed WiFi. The resort has a natural spring-fed swimming pool, a herbal steam sauna, and a fish pond with a fountain at its center.

## Key facts

- Location: 98 Moo 1, Baan Mae Yen, Mae Hee, Pai, Mae Hong Son, 58130, Thailand
- Distance to Pai walking street: 10-15 minute walk, short scooter ride
- Room types: Pond View Superior, Garden View Superior, Garden View Superior LUX, Family Studio Superior LUX, Pond View Superior LUX (15 bungalows total)
- All rooms include: air conditioning, private bathroom, free high-speed WiFi
- On-site amenities: natural mountain spring-fed swimming pool, herbal steam sauna, fish pond with fountain, Terrace View Restaurant (breakfast and light meals)
- Check-in: 2:00 PM / Check-out: 11:00 AM
- Parking: free, on-site, for cars and scooters
- Contact (outside Thailand): +66-83-875-5379
- Contact (inside Thailand): 083-875-5379
- Email: management.pairadise@gmail.com
- Booking: via Lodgify, linked from the homepage
- Rated 4.6 out of 5 from 230+ Google reviews
